implementation_after_approval.action: Configure the verified new API Key in the private FoloToy ASR2.0 runtime configuration. Authentication and isolated final recognition already passed; never embed the Key into the image, source, skill, argv or report.

Compare old/new models on identical audio: user names, technical terms, songs and ordinary commands; record transcription errors, total time, audio replay time and final-result wait separately. Synthetic speech only demonstrates availability.
Register the new engine in FoloToy STT dispatch and configuration mapping; keep the current provider as default. Build a new image with a precise backup and test actual loaded modules.
With user approval, enable ASR2.0 on role1 for a trial. Confirm real toy voice recognition, DeerFlow WS/fullAccess, TTS and music still work.
After successful trial, enable roles2-7. Keep the former image and role configuration for rollback.

failure_policy.validation: No automatic fallback; an ASR2.0 failure must remain visible in reports.
failure_policy.production_proposal: An optional bounded old-ASR fallback can be added separately; record the actual provider and never label fallback output ASR2.0.
